prompt.project_info: Japanese photobook-style close-up vintage portrait adapted from the source prompt and folder context.
prompt.main_subject: Clearly adult original Asian woman with hair and bangs, wearing a red spaghetti-strap dress; chin lifted in languid relaxation while gently holding a small red cherry tomato near the collarbone. Keep the gesture playful and non-sexual.
prompt.composition_elements: Extreme close-up from a low diagonal angle, face, neck and shoulder in focus, shallow background with red ribbons softly blurred.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Strong natural backlight from above creates dreamy halation and glowing rim light around the profile; warm creamy skin tones and vibrant red accents.
prompt.technical_specs: 50mm lens, approximately f/2.0, Kodak Portra 400-inspired warm vintage film, slight overexposure, visible grain and shallow depth of field.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Dreamy Japanese photobook-style vintage close-up of a clearly adult original Asian woman with hair and bangs in a red spaghetti-strap dress, chin lifted toward soft backlight while gently holding a small red cherry tomato near her collarbone, red ribbons blurred behind, low diagonal 50mm framing, glowing rim light, Portra 400 warmth, halation and visible analog grain.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, biometric identity, sexualized pose, logos, text, watermark, unrealistic features, distorted hands, extra fingers, deformed anatomy, harsh shadows
